cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(bar LANGUAGES CXX)
find_package(leaf CONFIG REQUIRED)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
set(BAR_GENERATED_BIAS 1)
configure_file(bar_config.h.in bar_config.h @ONLY)
add_library(bar bar.cc)
target_compile_features(bar PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_compile_options(bar PRIVATE -g -fno-inline "-ffile-prefix-map=${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}=tests/fixtures/conan/remote/recipes/bar/all")
target_include_directories(bar PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}" PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}>)
target_link_libraries(bar PUBLIC leaf::leaf Threads::Threads)
install(TARGETS bar ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib LIBRARY DESTINATION lib)
install(FILES forge_dependency.h "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/bar_config.h" DESTINATION include)
